approval_basis.source: current user approval to execute the captured work pack and treat bounded deterministic regeneration as lower-decision-cost evidence
approval_basis.scope: SWU-TSGR-002 exact seven declared material paths

recovery.initial_diagnostic: the validator attributed unrelated canonical Task Session siblings as undeclared producer outputs
recovery.historical_evidence_policy: preserve the first admission and failed live-validation evidence; issue a fresh recovery admission before replacing the validator

obligations.summary: Execute exactly the selected SWU-TSGR-002 seven-path schema family.
Bind the passing SWU-TSGR-001 terminal result and joined closeout receipt.
Bind the recovered Sigil Development producer receipt without treating repaired staging as SWU completion.
Classify six exact canonical outputs as already present and the repaired validator as the only byte-changing material write.
Require a fresh Invoke material receipt and fresh mutation admission before replacing the canonical validator.
Persist the terminal result only after the recovered validator passes in the live canonical tree.
Preserve closeout inventory and return SWU-TSGR-003 without executing it in this Task Session.

constraints: Execute exactly one SWU in this Task Session.
Admit the exact seven-path final material inventory even though six outputs already match.
Replace only the repaired validator bytes; do not rewrite the six exact outputs.
Preserve every unrelated dirty file and all historical SWU-TSGR-002 admission evidence.
Do not update generated mirrors, publish, promote, commit, push, deploy, or execute SWU-TSGR-003.
Persist the terminal Task Session result only after live validation and allowed-write reconciliation.

done_criteria.criterion: Every envelope is closed, versioned, and digest-bindable.
Predecessor, idempotency, allowed-write/output, timeout, and closeout fields are mandatory where applicable.
Fixtures reject shell strings, missing owner identity, skipped predecessor, and unbounded output.
The recovered validator ignores unrelated canonical siblings while strict producer-manifest mode rejects an eighth attributed output.
